text_fidelity_a:
Games The Original Tiny Hands Challenge Games- Tiny Hands Challenge Children's Toy has all the things that make for a great game- it’s challenging, fun, moves fast and has plenty of hilarious laughter. The game comes with: 2 tiny hands, 2 tinier hands, 3 sets of activity cards (151 total), 20 scoring tokens, 1 spinner, 1 string (shoe lace), 1 ball, 1 sand timer (time is one minute), 1 wager mat and instructions. You can play with 4-10 players and recommended age is 8 and up.

You begin by dividing into 2 teams- yellow and blue. You set up the wager mat and the 3 decks of cards. Then set out the hands, spinner, string, ball and sand timer. You play rock, paper, scissors to see who goes first. You spin the spinner to see which activity card you will do and which hands you will do it with- tiny or tinier. Some of the activities use pens, paper, cups and coins, so you will want to have these items available too.

Once you know what activity you must do with which hands, you make a wager. If you lose, your opponent gets the token points. Even if you win, your opponent can challenge you. The 3 sets of cards are: Solo, Pair and Charades. The timer being one minute long makes the challenges and charades almost impossible to finish in such a short time. Luckily, some of the challenges don’t use the timer and give you multiple tries. There is also a Face Off, where both teams do a challenge at the same time. Doing the challenges and charades in such a short time with these tiny hands is almost impossible and laughing so hard totally impossible. The first team to collect 31 token points wins. Great Fun, Challenges and Laughter. 5 STARS.
text_fidelity_b: Games The Original Tiny Hands Challenge

text_fidelity_a:
VIAHART Patrick The Pygmy Goat - 18 Inch Large Stuffed Animal Plush - by Tiger Tale Toys Oh, what have I done?

I bought Patrick the Pygmy Goat as a gift for my goat loving wife this past Christmas. Upon seeing it Christmas morning, her eyes lit up and she took to it immediately. I thought I had made the perfect choice.

Or so I thought.

I quickly found that it seems Patrick was always watching me. At night, he would sit atop the pillows on the bed watching over his new domain. Despite the fact his head seems to be affixed to only look to his left, it still seems he is looking at me no matter what side of the bed I’m on. When I tuck in my wife at night, he is there staring. When I come back from brushing my teeth, he is there staring. When I lift the sheets to turn over at night, he is there staring into my soul.

I’m pretty sure he is plotting against me. I can see him in the window looking down at me when I take the trash out to the street. I get phone calls with the sounds of capra aegagrus hircus breathing on the other end. Sometimes he is there under my feet when walking by or sitting on my chest when I wake.

I’ve spoken to my wife about my concerns, but she laughs them off. I’m starting to think she is in on it with the goat. With Patrick. Even now, he is watching me type.

Despite the above concerns, he appears to be a really great stuffed goat. My wife falls asleep with him in her arms each night as he whispers, whatever it is he is saying, into her ear.
text_fidelity_b: VIAHART Patrick The Pygmy Goat - 18 Inch Large Stuffed Animal Plush - by Tiger Tale Toys

It doesn't break unless really forced to. The sprinkles and charm are nice editions and my daughter was surprised that the paper straw released readily from the slime.
The big oversight is that all of the imagery shows off the fun of combining the two colors together. The first problem that causes is one of storage. The two colors come separately packed in small containers with no extra room. This means if you combine them, you have no where to store the combined slime. Also, this should be fairly obvious, but as soon as you start mixing the colors it takes about 5 seconds for the red and white to simply become a pink. You could make the swirl shown in the product photos, but you'd never be able to interact with it without forever just having a pink slime.

It snaps together well and the versatility of being able to easily switch out the rooms is pretty clever. If I was a kid I would probably love this - but I think I'd want it to be more structure to it. It's more like a stage backdrop - but then I guess it is all about make believe anyhow so helps to spur the imagination. Would be neat if they could have figured out a way to make it fold up like a case - similar to the way the old Barbie Friend Ship (airplane) did. (You'll have to google it to see what I mean- had one of those when I was a kid and played with it for hours!) That would have made it super easy to store and put away.

I do really like the versatility, as I mentioned earlier. There aren't as many accessories to it as I would have thought, especially given the price for this plastic castle. The details in the design are neat - with the tree-like pieces holding up the second floor. The clips to hold the dolls into place is also a great touch so the girls can pose the dolls into their scenes. This is going to provide hours of fun for my niece who is a huge Ever After High fan.

text_fidelity_a:
Radio Flyer Deluxe Big Flyer, Outdoor Toy for Kids Ages 3-7, Red Toddler Bike Coming from a family of mostly boys and Big Wheel lovers, I know these current low riding Big Wheels are not the same quality as my little brother's Big Wheel from 1971. My brother loved his Big Wheel so much, that my son also had to have one when he was 3. Even though he was too small, he didn't care- walking it was just as good as riding it.

Things haven't changed much in the design, the big wheel bikes are all still too large for children under 4-5, but the quality has changed a lot for the original Big Wheel. After replacing the back seat 3 times, the original current Big Wheel of our nephew's recently went to the garbage. Replacing the Big Wheel with a tricycle was even worse- after a couple turns- the head injuries even with a helmet proved to be going from a cheap big wheel to bruises.

This Radio Flyer Deluxe Big Flyer is very similar to the Big Wheel of the seventies- very sturdy. The seat doesn't break at the pegs like the current Big Wheel. It is still too large for children under 5, but they don't care- they enjoy just having it, even if they have to walk it. They use their feet anyway for braking, so they don't mind walking it until their feet reach the pedals. My son walked his Big Wheel for a year before he could reach the pedals.

The best thing about this Radio Flyer Deluxe Big Flyer is our nephews love it. Taking the fastest high speed turns ends up in falls inches from the ground- meaning less painful minor injuries. My brother and son never had a bad injury being so close to the ground and this was in the days of no head protection. Putting it together was not difficult with the directions and once together, it's hard to keep the kids off. It's nice to see Radio Flyer keeping the tradition of making a sturdy Big Flyer that is perfect for 4 to 7 year olds, just like in the seventies when things were built to last.
text_fidelity_b: Radio Flyer Deluxe Big Flyer, Outdoor Toy for Kids Ages 3-7, Red Toddler Bike

Thames & Kosmos TK1 Telescope Plus Astronomy Educational Science Kit | Refractor 60/700 | Aluminum Full Size Tripod with Altazimuth Mount | 35X, 70X, 140X Power | Parents' Choice Recommended I'm not quite the telescope connoisseur, though I'm quite well versed in optics (avid photographer), and I've discovered there's a bit of a gulf between the "wouldn't it be nice to have a telescope" and those sold to diehard astronomers. This one falls into the former category, and as such I"m not really comparing this to higher end models.

In the lower end realm, I still expect clear optics, no noticeable optical defects, and a stable base. This one checks those boxes. The optics look clean and clear to the naked eye, though lab testing would show where higher end models excel, and it's not the brightest lens (all lenses lose some light due to transmission loss in lens materials and dispersal), but it met my expectations. The tripod is well built enough for this model telescope, but it's no remarkable. As it's geared towards budding astronomers, especially youngsters, the included guide and list of projects to get you going is definitely a strength.

4 stars due to no faults of it's own, though it's not that remarkable either. Recommended, though may want to consider other models.
text_fidelity_b: Thames & Kosmos TK1 Telescope Plus Astronomy Educational Science Kit | Refractor 60/700 | Aluminum Full Size Tripod with Altazimuth Mount | 35X, 70X, 140X Power | Parents' Choice Recommended

My wife and I saw this Rockin' Rider Legacy Grow-with-Me Pony at our young nephew's second birthday party. It looked very sturdy, was colorful and well-built, and the children were lining up to give it a try. Since we had our granddaughter's second birthday coming up we decided to order one for her.

Safety is of course a big concern when buying something for any young child. However this particular rocking horse is well stabilized and provides extra protection as far as balance. Of course children can fall down at a moment's notice and for any number of reasons so it makes sense to always watch your child in whatever activity they're involved in.

Safer than the original rocking horse designs, painted with vivid colors, and having a very low center of gravity -- and thus superior balance and stability -- this Rockin' Rider keeps our granddaughter entertained daily, at least until she tires of it and moves on looking for other things to get into. Highly recommended as the safest rocking horse we've seen.

(And I mean things quickly deteriorated into a 5-cousin brawl of boys and girls ages 2-7 until the board was put away because everyone wanted it!)

Children LOOOOVE making rubber band designs and this 11x11 inch board allows for some cool ones. You can buy colored rubber bands on Amazon but I recommend grabbing a bag of neon bright bands for under five at an office supply store. The very few (like 12 total?) it came with were a rubber-eraser reddish-pink, dusty white and vintage spearmint green. They are fairly gross looking colors and except for the white, the rest reside permanently in the bottom of the rubber band bag.

When it arrived our board was yellow, which I liked MUCH better than the red shown but be aware you'll get a random color. The one we just ordered in October 2013 for a cousin christmas gift (since it was such a hit!) was also yellow. Every time my son pulls it out in church, children in the pews in front of us and behind us begin quietly peeking over his work to see what he's making with that contraption and everyone wants a turn! If you need a fun toy for kids of all ages that won't break the bank, doesn't require batteries or make any noise and builds brain cells while you play, this is it!

Eighty Eight Miracles Mystical Gold Foil and Black Tarot Cards with Guide Book for Beginner Tarot Readers; Large Tarot Deck Extensive Guidebook Symbolic Meanings of Past History and Future Destiny This set would be a most worthy gift to those new and old to the Tarot, it's packed in a gorgeous and sturdy black and gold foil box, the guide book has over 280 pages, and the cards are a little wider than "standard", making them a little easier to handle (I think).

I was intrigued by the additional reading info based on card position offered by the item description (I've never see it offerende before) and was temporarily blown away by the presentation of the set. Once I got over that, I dug into guide.
Reading info for Major Arcana cards- general meaning and interpretation (upright), love and relationships (upright), money and career (upright), general meaning and interpretation (reversed), love and relationships (reversed) & money and career (reversed)
Reading info for Minor Arcana cards- general, love, career, reversed general, reversed love & reversed career
I think this will go a long way to helping folks become familiar with the cards rather than viewing a reversed card as strictly an opposite meaning.

Despite its somewhat simple looking art that is pretty faithful to Waite-Rider imagery, there's something very appealing about this deck, for lack of a better term, it feels "open". I know my picture doesn't highlight this, the edges of the cards are gilded as well. I am very pleased with this deck and look forward to having it for a very, very long time.

LEGO Star Wars Death Star (10188) (Discontinued by manufacturer) From the pictures, this looked kind of goofy at first. I really wanted the other Death Star, but that's much harder to find than this one. This one is still super rare, and I didn't fall in love with it until we put it together. It has so many cool scenes from the movies, and so many working parts. It even has a removable tie fighter, with a tie fighter hanger. It's got a ton of cool figures that I haven't seen anywhere else, like R2-D2, Assassin Droid, R2-Q5, Protocol Droid, Interrogation Droid, Palpatine, Darth Vader, Imperial Trooper, Luke Skywalker (Jedi, Stormtrooper, and Tatooine), Obi Wan Kenobi, Han Solo (Stormtrooper and Black Vest), Stormtrooper, Princess Leia, C-3PO, Grand Moff Tarkin, Mouse Guard, Royal Guard, and Chewie.

It took four of us two full days to put this together, over Christmas holidays, but it was well worth the effort. The scale is a little strange, but it's that way in almost any lego set. We calculated that if they made a Lego Death Star to the scale where people would actually make sense, then it would have to be 2 miles across. So, they had to make some design choices so that a lot of stuff isn't really to scale. For reference, the real Death Star is 100 miles across. This set does mix up different scenes from two different movies. But, they're really cool scenes. A lot of the parts work, like you can crush Luke and Leia in the trash compactor and you can move and aim the Death Star ray on two different axes.

The instruction book is ginormous. There are about 500 different steps in total. It's spiral bound, and you have to be really careful so that it doesn't rip. Overall, this is an epic set, and I highly recommend this to anyone who's an expert with Legos.
text_fidelity_b: LEGO Star Wars Death Star (10188) (Discontinued by manufacturer)

ALEX Jr. My Busy Barn I've bought some of the Alex Toys for the children in our family, but this is the first Alex Junior Toy we've owned. Alex Toys are known for their sturdiness, well made enough to pass on to future generations, wonderful educational and imagination values and gorgeous vivid colors. This beautiful barn is no exception with it's sturdiness, educational value and vivid bright colors.

This barn is very sturdy, weighing over 10 pounds and made of both very smooth wood and wood products. You can easily see this lasting for future generations of babies to learn with. There are 6 sides of the barn for learning and play. The 2 sides of the roof are beautifully colored with numbers and corresponding food items- such as the number 8, shows eight ears of corn. One side of the barn has 3 barn doors that when opened, baby can see the animals living inside. The other side of the barn, has a windmill, cloud and sun that, being gears, all turn each other when moved.

The large back of the barn has a moveable tractor, cow and rooster. Baby can move these inside the tracks, so nothing comes loose. The front of the barn includes the most wonderful spinning wood blocks of the alphabet with accompanying pictures. There is a darling owl for the letter O, a cute donkey for the letter D and all the pictures that accompany the letters of the alphabet are not only adorable, but beautifully colored. We have twins in our family and this barn being 6 sided allows them to play on different sides at the same time.

I remember wood alphabet blocks being passed down from one generation to another in our family, but this gorgeous barn will replace that tradition. This barn makes it easy and fun for baby to learn both the alphabet and their numbers at the same time. Our babies love the vivid colors and they love learning that 2 means counting 2 items and that the sound of the letter J sounds like Jam. This is a beautiful barn that your baby will love learning their ABC's and 123's with. It's 5 Star Learning Fun that will last many generations to come.
text_fidelity_b: ALEX Jr. My Busy Barn

Feleph Jungle Trees Building Blocks Bricks with 2 Base Plates (10 Inches for Each), Forest Garden Plants Flowers Bushes Animals Kit, Botanical Parts Scenery Toys Compatible with Major Brands LEGO would never make something like this. Sure, you can take their stuff and make anything with them, but too many of their kits make a definitive something. This is a definitive nothing, but a nothing that can entertain far beyond what a lot of different "somethings" can do.

LEGO is a toy, and this is often something that they remember to a fault. Here is a LEGO competitor, with bricks that are compatible, that remembers that it's not always a toy that kids want. They want an experience of playing, and that's what this Forest Garden kit gives them. Is it a dinosaur jungle? Is it a very nice tropical garden? Are the characters running from that alligator, or picnicing i the woods? With this, more than with any LEGO kit I've ever reviewed, there is a limitless number of possibilities.

There are no instructions with this kit, which is somewhat bothersome for the finnicky children who need a "right" way to put them together, but the playscape this provides is so unique that I can't give it less than 5 stars.

text_fidelity_a: Monterey LG8510 Lady Bug Lure, Pack of 3 I buy these lures each year ever since I learned that ladybugs like to cluster in small hollow space in houses. One year I had 1 exterior wall with over 1000 ladybugs crawling on it in the sunshine, a day later they were all gone and over the following weeks they started falling out of the cracks inside my house. Every morning as soon as the sun rose I would start finding them everywhere. I checked the internet and found the Ladybuglady who told me that ladybugs cluster in the late fall to stay warm through the winter. If they find a space like a house and a way in they will literally take over the sun side wall of the house. The way to avoid this was to build ladybug houses (similar to bird house but with smaller holes) and place them in your garden and orchards where the Ladybugs will benefit your plants (they eat aphids) and get these lures to draw them to the houses. Well for 2 years it has worked like a charm. No ladybugs in my houses and the trees in my orchard are doing very well.
text_fidelity_b: Monterey LG8510 Lady Bug Lure, Pack of 3

text_fidelity_a: Backyard Discovery Sweetwater All Cedar White Modern Outdoor Wooden Playhouse, Cottage, Sink, Stove, Windows, Kitchen with Pot and Pans and Utensils, Flowerpot Holders, Working Doorbell, Ages 2-6 We've had this playhouse for a couple of months and it still looks brand new - despite the Iowa sun, our extreme heat and rain and freezes.  When we opened up the package, we had a couple of issues with the wood being cracked.  The overall setup is fairly easy if you follow the directions.  Customer service was really great working with when I called to get replacement parts.  To be clear, though, I wasn't aware that we'd have to seal the playhouse.  I only found that out because I'd called for replacement parts.  We used a marine sealant and it is full waterproofing!  We used a chemical pump sprayer to apply it (we sprayed it on and then brushed over it - it is very runny like milk and goes on white but dries clear).  I, originally, expected the wood to be pre-sealed since it was a playhouse specifically for outside.  So, in hindsight, I am very grateful that we talked with the helpful customer service person.  Otherwise, we'd probably have to be replacing the house next year ... and, I wouldn't have been very happy with the purchase.  However, we've had it a couple months now and it still looks brand new!  I'd highly recommend this playhouse IF you are willing to seal it.  Yes, marine clear coat is expensive but so was the playhouse.  All in all, a great addition to our backyard and I'm sure we'll get several years of grandchildren's fun with it!
text_fidelity_b: Backyard Discovery Sweetwater All Cedar White Modern Outdoor Wooden Playhouse, Cottage, Sink, Stove, Windows, Kitchen with Pot and Pans and Utensils, Flowerpot Holders, Working Doorbell, Ages 2-6

text_fidelity_a: Osmo - Reading Adventure - Advanced Reader for iPad + Access to 4 More Books - Ages 5-7 - Builds Reading Proficiency, Phonics, Fluency, Comprehension & Sight Words iPad Base Required US ONLY I was skeptical this would do as much as promised for 25$ but lavar burton wouldnt lead me wrong right?? The game is cute and has mostly functional listening software. My son cant probounce r’s and the software recognizes it 99% of the time. This is a huge game but you can do a respectable amount with the first four books. You can only get more books with a subscription which makes sense i am assuming this product is a loss leader, year of monthly sets of 4 books is 250$. The only thing that really doesnt work if that theres four mini games outside of the main storyline and the ‘story stone’ game basically scrolls text up whether you are reading or not preventing us from actually reading the text. The other games work very well. The wand concept and the reflector. Are great concepts and work well. It does not follow tiny steps of progression like Bob’s books or a proper school curriculum, lots of things like multi syllable words and vowel combos, hard vowels etc are introduced randomly so needs some parent engagement. Overall i am impressed and signed up for a limited subscription. My son loves it.
text_fidelity_b: Osmo - Reading Adventure - Advanced Reader for iPad + Access to 4 More Books - Ages 5-7 - Builds Reading Proficiency, Phonics, Fluency, Comprehension & Sight Words iPad Base Required US ONLY
